members.narration: Using my right hand, grab the coffee beans bag from the kitchen top.
Using my right hand, open the top drawer by pulling the drawer with my right index finger.
Pick up the scissors, with my right hand, from the top drawer I just opened.
With my left hand, put down the coffee beans bag back where it was on the kitchen top.
While holding the scissors in my right hand, using my left hand, remove the safety cover from the scissors.
Put down the scissors safety cover on the kitchen top between the bread and the coffee beans bag.
Using both hands, grab again the coffee beans bag from the kitchen top.
While holding the coffee beans bag in my left hand, using my right hand, open the coffee beans bag by cutting the top part with the scissors.
Put down the scissors from my right hand on the kitchen top near the bread.
With my right hand, grab the scissor safety cover from the kitchen top.
With my right hand, grab the scissors from the kitchen top while still holding the scissors safety cover in the right hand.
Slide the scissors safety cover on the tip of the scissors with my right hand while holding the scissors and the coffee beans bag in my left hand.
Place the scissors in the top drawer with my right hand.
With my right hand, push the top drawer to close it.
With my right hand, open the large cupboard on the right hand side.
I'm looking for a specific spoon that I use for coffee beans in the cutlery tray, but I don't find it.
Open the dishwasher with my right hand to look for the coffee bean spoon I was looking for in the cutlery tray earlier.
With my right hand, pick up the red coffee beans spoon from the cutlery tray located in the bottom rack of the dishwasher.
Using my right hand, close the dishwasher by pulling the door.
With my left hand, put down the coffee beans bag on the kitchen top next to the rice cooker.
With my left hand, pick up again the coffee beans bag from the kitchen top.
While holding the coffee beans bag in my left hand, using the red spoon that I'm holding in my right hand, scoop coffee beans from the bag.
Put down the coffee bean bag on the kitchen top with my left hand.
Using my left hand, grab the top lid of the coffee grinder.
Put down the coffee grinder lid on the kitchen top next to the coffee grinder.
With my right hand, lift the coffee beans bag while holding the spoon at the same time, then use the left hand to hold the coffee beans bag more steadily.
Tilt the red spoon above the top compartment of the coffee grinder to drop the coffee beans inside the coffee grinder.
While holding the coffee beans bag with my left hand, scoop another spoonful of coffee beans from the bag using my right hand.
Tilt the spoon again above the top compartment of the coffee grinder to drop more coffee beans inside the coffee grinder.
Put down the red coffee bean spoon on the kitchen top next to the coffee grinder.
With my right hand, grab the coffee grinder top lid from the kitchen top.
Place the top lid on the coffee grinder.
I turn on the coffee grinder by pushing the button with my right thumb.
Having realized that the coffee grinder is not grinding the coffee beans, turn off the coffee grinder by pushing the button on the top with my right thumb.
Using my right hand, move the coffee grinder by turning it twice on the kitchen top to have a look at what is going on with the coffee grinder.

Having realized that the problem is that the coffee beans didn't go down where they are supposed to go in the coffee grinder, using my right hand, shake the coffee grinder vigorously so that the coffee beans lower in the bottom part of the coffee grinder.
With my right hand, lift the top lid of the coffee grinder to have a look inside the top compartment.
I put down the top lid of the coffee grinder on the kitchen top using my right hand.
With my right hand, pick up the coffee grinder top lid from the kitchen top.
Place the lid on the top of the coffee grinder using my right hand.
Turn on again the coffee grinder by pushing the button on the top of the grinder.
Because the grinder is still not grinding coffee beans, tap the top part of the grinder repeatedly to try to lower the beans into the grinding chamber of the coffee grinder.

Grab the coffee grinder while it is on and shake it vigorously and tilting it slightly upwards which eventually lowers the coffee beans into the grinding chamber of the coffee grinder which results in eventually and finally grinding coffee beans.
Put down the coffee beans bag on the kitchen top and hold it upright with both hands.
Seal the coffee beans bag using both hands by rolling the top part of the bag on itself multiple times.
With my right hand, open the large cupboard on the right hand side.
With my right hand, grab a clip located inside a box which is in the top shelf of the lower cupboard which I haven't opened but I can still reach from the top cupboard.
With my right hand, close the cupboard by pulling the cupboard.
Attach the clip on the top part of the coffee beans bag so that the bag is well sealed.
Open the cupboard by pulling it with my right hand.
Place the coffee beans bag in a box located in the middle shelf of the cupboard.
As I tried to place the coffee bean bag in the middle shelf of the cardboard, I knocked the clip that was attached to the coffee bean bag and now I catch it with my left hand.
Roll again the top side of the coffee beans bag, using both hands, to seal the bag one more time.
Attach the clip again on the top side of the coffee beans bag to close the bag well.
Place the coffee beans bag again in the middle shelf of the cupboard. This time I do this more slowly and more carefully so that I don't remove the clip again.
Close the cupboard using my left hand.
With my left hand, pick up the kettle from the kitchen top.
Open the kettle by pushing a button located on the top of the kettle with my left thumb.
While holding the kettle above the sink under the tap with my left hand, using my right hand, turn on the tap and fill the kettle with tap water.
Turn off tap using my right hand.
Having realized by hearing the sound of the coffee grinder that the grinder hadn't fully ground all the coffee beans, turn on the coffee grinder again by pushing the button on the top of the grinder.
With my right hand, pick up the piece of coffee beans bag that I previously cut off from the bag when I opened it with the scissors.
With my right hand, open the soft plastic recycling bin by pulling the lid upwards.
Close the recycling bin by letting go of the lid.
Drop the piece of coffee beans bag inside the soft plastic recycling bin with my right hand.
Grab another piece of plastic that accidentally got out when I opened the recycling bin. The piece of plastic hasn't fallen to the ground but is hanging from the lid of the bin.
With my left hand, open the recycling bin lid.
With my right hand, push the plastic piece that was getting out of the bin and apply some force to compress the soft plastic inside the bin so that no plastic gets out again.
While compressing the plastic inside the bin, I dropped another piece of plastic on the floor, which I'm now picking up with my right hand.
With my left hand open one more time the soft plastic recycling bin by pulling the lid.
With my right hand, place the plastic that I just picked up from the floor back into the recycling bin.
Press again the plastic inside the recycling bin to try one more time to compress the plastic and prevent it from getting out of the bin.
Close the recycling bin by letting go of the lid with my left hand.
I turn off the coffee grinder by pushing the button on top of the grinder with my right hand.
Trying to pull the coffee grinder bottom compartment with my right hand, giving up because the coffee grinder is not stable, because the grinder lead is making the grinder wobble.
Using both hands, pull the coffee grinder so that the power lead is not trapped on the underside of the coffee grinder and that the coffee grinder doesn't wobble.
Now that the coffee grinder is stable, pull the coffee grinder bottom compartment with my right hand.

Using both hands, tilt the coffee grinder box containing the ground coffee, tilt the box above the V60 coffee filter, while holding the box closed by holding the lid in place with my left hand and tapping the container to ensure that all coffee ground is poured into the V60 filter.
Using my right hand shake the V60 coffee filter horizontally by sliding it along the kitchen or multiple times to ensure that the coffee ground is evenly distributed.
Continue tapping on the coffee grinder box to shake the ground coffee of the grinder container into the V60 filter.
Now that most of the coffee ground is poured into the filter, remove the coffee grinder container lid with my left hand so that I can pour the remaining ground coffee into the filter.
Shake the now open coffee grinder box above the coffee filter to pour the remaining bits of loose ground coffee into the filter.
With my left hand, attach the lid to the top of the coffee grinder box that I'm holding in my right hand.
With my right hand, put down the coffee grinder box on the kitchen top next to the bread.
With my left hand, pull the coffee grinder slightly towards me, the coffee grinder is located in the corner of the kitchen top.
With my left hand, open cupboard above the hob.
With my right hand lift a coffee bag located in the middle shelf of the cupboard. See that this is not the coffee I want to use now.
With my left hand, reach inside the box where the coffee bag that I'm holding in my right hand was located to grab a bag of coffee beans that I want to use now.
With my right hand, gently push the coffee bag down that I am not going to use to make the coffee bag flat on top of the box, located in the middle shelf of the cupboard.
With my left hand, close the cupboard above the hob.
With my right hand, open the larger cupboard on the right hand side of the kitchen.
With my right hand, pick up the red coffee spoon from the cutlery tray located in the middle shelf of the cupboard.
With my right hand, close the cupboard by pulling the cupboard first towards me and then pushing it.
While walking towards the coffee grinder, remove the clip from the coffee beans bag using my right hand.
Place the clip that I just removed from the coffee beans bag on the kitchen top next to the cloth.
With my right hand, lift the coffee grinder top lid.
With my right hand, put down the coffee grinder lid on the kitchen top next to the grinder.
With my right hand, tilt the coffee grinder to check if there are any beans inside the coffee grinder.
Put down again the coffee grinder and push it slightly towards the wall using my left hand.
Grab the coffee grinder again and move it a little bit to the right along the kitchen top.

Because after moving the coffee grinder the grinder is now standing on its lid, with the left hand, lift the coffee grinder to make sure the coffee grinder lid is not trapped under the coffee grinder itself.
While holding the coffee grinder with my left hand, using my right hand pull the coffee grinder lid so that the lid doesn't stand trapped underneath the coffee grinder.
With my right hand, pick up the coffee grinder top lid from the kitchen top next to the coffee grinder.
Place the coffee grinder top lid on the coffee grinder.
Using my right hand, push the coffee grinder first to the right and then to the left.
Using my right thumb, push the button on the top of the coffee grinder to turn on the coffee grinder and grind the coffee beans.
Using both hands, close the coffee beans bag by rolling the top part of the bag on itself several times.
Place the red coffee spoon in the bottom shelf of the drying rack, located on the right hand side of the sink.
Continue wiping the kitchen top with my right hand using the orange cloth.
Open cupboard above the left side of the hob with my right hand.
Grab coffee beans bag from the middle shelf of the cupboard I just opened.
Close cupboard by pushing it.
While holding the coffee beans bag midair with my left hand, remove the clip from the coffee beans bag with my right hand.
Put down the clip I just removed from the coffee beans bag onto the kitchen top.
Grab coffee grinder towards me and briefly pull it towards me.
Grab coffee grinder lid to remove it.
Put down coffee grinder lid with my right hand while at the same time putting down coffee beans bag onto the kitchen top with my left hand.
Open coffee beans bag by unrolling the bag with both hands.
Enlarge the opening of the bag to allow me to pour coffee beans later on into the grinder.
While holding the coffee beans back midair with my left hand, grab the red coffee spoon from the kitchen top with my right hand.
Using my right hand and the red spoon, scoop coffee from the coffee beans bag that I'm holding with my left hand mid air.
While holding the coffee beans bag near the top of the coffee grinder, drop the beans I just scooped from the spoon into the coffee grinder.
While holding the coffee beans back with my left hand midair scoop coffee with my right hand using the red spoon.
While holding the coffee beans bag near the top of the coffee grinder with my left hand drop the coffee beans from the spoon into the coffee grinder.
Put down red spoon in my right hand onto the countertop near the coffee grinder.
Try to turn on the coffee grinder by pushing the button on the top without succeeding because the coffee grinder lid is not on.
Grab coffee grinder lid from the kitchen top with my right hand.
Put coffee grinder lid in place on the top of the grinder with my right hand.
Turn on coffee grinder by pushing the button on the top with my right thumb.
Close coffee beans bag by rolling it on itself.
Place the coffee box lid into the box.
Place the coffee box back in position inside the coffee grinder by pushing the box with my right hand while holding the coffee grinder with my left hand.
Briefly shake V60 with both hands to make the ground coffee even inside the cone.
Lift the V60 containing the ground coffee with both hands.
Close the kettle lid by pushing it downwards with my right hand.
Place the kettle on its base, which is located on the kitchen top between the microwave oven and the rice cooker.
With my left hand, turn on the kettle by flicking the switch located at the bottom of the kettle.
With my left hand, lift the coffee beans that are standing on top of the ground coffee bag so that I can pull the ground coffee bag without pulling the bag of coffee beans as well.
With my left hand, close the cupboard above the hob.
Pour the ground coffee bag on the kitchen top next to the coffee jug.
With my left hand, pick up a kettle from its base, which is standing on the kitchen top between the microwave oven and the rice cooker.
Open the kettle with my left hand by pushing the button located on the top side of the kettle handle.
With my right hand, turn on the tap while holding the kettle under the tap with my left hand.
Fill the kettle with tap water.
With my right hand, turn off the tap.
Close the kettle by pushing the kettle lid down with my right hand.
Place the kettle on its base, which is located on the kitchen top between the rice cooker and the microwave oven.
With my right hand, turn on the kettle by flicking the switch on the kettle base.
With the left hand, lift the kettle located between the microwave oven and the rice cooker.
Put the kettle down again on its base with my left hand.
Turn on the kettle with the left hand by switching the lever at the bottom of the kettle.
Turn off the coffee grinder with my right hand by pushing the button on the top of the grinder.
Pick up the metal V60 coffee filter with my right hand from the top shelf of the drying rack located on the sink.
With my right hand shake the V60 coffee filter above the sink to remove excess water.
Let go of the orange cloth with my right hand.
Grab kettle with my left hand.
Open kettle by pushing the button.
Check water level inside the kettle.
Turn on tap while holding the kettle underneath the tap.
Fill kettle with cold water.
Turn off tap.
Closed kettle by pushing its lid with my right index.
Place kettle onto its base with my left hand.
Switch on kettle with my left hand by pushing the button on the bottom.
Drop the cloth that I am holding in my left hand on the kitchen top next to the kitchen roll.
Using both hands, grab the V60 coffee filter from the kitchen top.
Place the V60 coffee filter on top of the coffee jug. I do this slowly and carefully so that the V60 filter doesn't fall off.
Holding both the coffee jug and the V60 filter, push the jug and the coffee filter along the kitchen top from right to left.
With my right hand, pick up the kettle from the kitchen top.
With my right hand, open the top cupboard by pulling the cupboard.
With my left hand, pick up black coffee spoon from the cutlery tray located at the bottom shelf of the top cupboard.
Put down the black coffee spoon on the kitchen top next to the coffee bag with my right hand.
With my left hand, grab the coffee jug and slide it slightly along the kitchen top to make room for the coffee bag that I'm going to open now.
Open the ground coffee bag by pulling the two sides of the bag using both hands.
With my right hand, pick up a ground coffee bag from the kitchen top.
With my right hand, pick up the V60 metal filter from the kitchen top.
Put the V60 metal filter down on the kitchen top next to the coffee jug.
With my right hand, pick up a black coffee spoon from the kitchen top.
With my right hand, scoop a spoonful of ground coffee from the bag using the black coffee spoon.

Tilt the black coffee spoon above the V60 metal filter to drop the ground coffee into the filter, holding the coffee bag near the V60 filter so that if I spill any ground coffee it gets inside the filter and not on the kitchen top.
Tap the black coffee spoon with my right index finger to shake off more ground coffee. So that the coffee falls into the V60 filter.
Scoop another spoonful of ground coffee from the ground coffee bag using the black coffee spoon.
Drop the ground coffee from the black coffee spoon into the V60 metal filter by tilting the spoon above the metal filter so that the ground coffee falls into the V60 filter.
Tap the black spoon with my right index finger to shake off any ground coffee from the spoon.
Put the black coffee spoon down into the sink with my right hand.
Shake the V60 filter with both hands so that the ground coffee is distributed evenly inside the filter.
With my right hand, place the V60 metal filter on top of the empty coffee jug.
With my left hand, grab the coffee jug and pull it towards myself, sliding it along the kitchen top.
Using my right hand, pick up a coffee jug from the top shelf of the cupboard located in the other corner of the kitchen.
Using my right hand, pick up the V60 rack from the top shelf of the cupboard.
Put the coffee jug down on the kitchen top above the washing machine.
Put down the V60 rack on the kitchen top between the sink and the coffee jug.
With my left hand, close the cupboard.
With my left hand, pick up the V60 coffee filter from the sink.
With my right hand, turn on the tap.

Using running tap water rinse the V60 metal filter. I do this because the dishwasher didn't clean the filter properly and there is still coffee residue. I use my hands by rubbing the fingers against the inner side of the V60 filter to remove the coffee residue and flip the filter a few times to remove excess water as I wash the filter.
Turn off the tap using my right hand.
Shake the V60 metal filter above the sink to remove excess water from the filter.
Place the V60 coffee filter on the drying rack located next to the sink.
Using first the right hand and immediately after the left hand, grab the coffee beans bag from the kitchen top.
Open the coffee beans bag by pulling the sides of the bag using the right hand.
Pick up the red coffee spoon from the kitchen top using my right hand.
Scoop coffee beans from the coffee beans bag using the red coffee spoon that I just picked up.
Stretch both hands towards the coffee grinder so that I am closer to the coffee grinder when I have to drop the coffee beans inside the grinder.
Drop the coffee beans inside the coffee grinder by tilting the red coffee spoon that I'm holding with my right hand.
Since I'm preparing two cups of coffee, scoop another spoon of coffee beans with my right hand using the red coffee spoon.
Drop the second spoonful of coffee beans inside the coffee grinder by tilting the spoon with my right hand.
Put down the red coffee spoon on the kitchen top next to the coffee grinder.
Place the metal V60 coffee filter on its rack, which is located on the kitchen top.
Without letting go of the V60 filter, lift the filter and place it on top of the coffee jug that is standing next to the filter.
Using both hands, move the coffee jug slightly and pull it towards me.
With my right hand, grab the cloth from the kitchen top next to the hob.
With my right hand, pull the coffee grinder bottom drawer containing the coffee that has just been ground.
With my left hand, grab the V60 coffee filter that is standing on top of the coffee jug and put it down on the kitchen top.

Pour the ground coffee into the V60 coffee filter by tilting the ground coffee container so that coffee grounds fall into the filter and tapping the container so that all the coffee is poured into the filter. While doing this I'm holding the lid of the container with the left hand in place so that I don't make a mess while pouring the coffee.

Now that there is less coffee in the container, remove the lid from the container and pour the remaining ground coffee from the container and the lid by tapping both against the rim of the coffee filter.
Put the lid on the top of the container using the left hand.
Put the coffee container with my right hand on the kitchen top.
Turn off the kettle with my left hand by flicking the switch at the bottom of the kettle.
With my left hand, pick up the kettle since the water is now boiled and is ready to be poured to make coffee.
Put down the kettle on the kitchen top next to the V60 coffee filter.
With my right hand, grab the v60 coffee filter from the kitchen top.
With my left hand, grab the coffee jug and move it slightly to the right along the kitchen top.
Stack the V60 coffee filter on top of the coffee jug so that I can later pour water into the filter and into the jug.
With my left hand, move the coffee jug first to the left and then outwards along the kitchen top.
With my left hand grab and rotate the coffee jug from the kitchen top without actually lifting it. With my right hand pull the box containing the ground coffee from the coffee grinder.
With my left hand move the coffee jug by sliding it along the kitchen top.
With my right hand pull towards me the V60 coffee filter.
With my right hand, grab the box containing the ground coffee.

Pour ground coffee from the box into the V60 filter by tilting the box to let the ground coffee fall into the filter while keeping the box lid into place with my left hand and tapping the back of the box with my right hand.
Shake box horizontally to drop all the coffee from the box into the filter.
While holding the coffee box with my right hand, with my left hand remove the box lid to drop all the coffee into the V60 filter.
Tap the open coffee box against the V60 filter to drop all the coffee into the filter.
Tap the coffee box against the coffee lid to shake the ground coffee and drop it into the V60 filter.
Lower the V60 with both hands as to put down the filter onto the kitchen top without actually putting it down then lifting it again.
Grab coffee jug with my left hand while holding the V60 midair with my right hand.
Slide the coffee jug with my left hand to position the coffee jug under the V60 that I'm holding with my right hand.
Place the V60 coffee filter that I'm holding in my right hand on top of the coffee jug that I'm holding with my left hand.
Pick up kettle with my right hand.
Pour water from the kettle into the V60 coffee filter following a rotating motion to brew coffee more evenly.
While holding the red coffee bean spoon under the tap with my right hand, turn on the tap.
Quickly rinse the red coffee bean spoon using running tap water by moving the spoon and flipping it to remove excess water.
Shake the red coffee beans spoon with my right hand above the sink to remove excess water.
With my left hand, grab the cloth hanging from the cupboard next to the sink.
Use the cloth to dry the red coffee bean spoon.
Open the dishwasher by pulling the dishwasher door downwards.
Pick up coffee jug from the dishwasher bottom rack using my right hand.
Using my right hand, pull the dishwasher top rack towards me.
With my right hand, put down the coffee jug on the kitchen top next to the rice cooker.
With my left hand, pick up coffee cup from the centre of the dishwasher top rack.
With my right hand, put down the coffee cup on the kitchen top next to the coffee jug.
With my left hand, pick up another coffee cup from the centre of the dishwasher top rack.
With my left hand, push the dishwasher top rack inside the dishwasher.
With my right hand, put the coffee cup on the kitchen top next to the coffee jug.
Close the dishwasher by pulling the door upwards with my left hand.
With my right hand, pick up a coffee jug from the kitchen top. The coffee jug is located between the two coffee cups.
While holding the coffee jug under the tap with my left hand, using my right hand turn on the tap.
Using running tap water, rinse the coffee jug by moving it in a rotating pattern horizontally.
With my left hand, tilt the coffee jug in order to empty the jug and drop water into the sink.
With my right hand, turn off the tap.
Hold the jug face down above the sink and shake it so that most of the water escapes the jug.
While holding and shaking the coffee jug in my right hand, with my left hand, pick up the cloth from the cupboard next to the sink.
Use the cloth that I'm holding in my left hand to dry the coffee jug that I just rinsed, which I'm holding in my right hand.
Put down the coffee jug on the kitchen top next to the V60 filter.
Tilt the kettle to pour water into the V60 filter. I do this slowly and in a rotating motion so that coffee is brewed properly.
Put down the kettle on the kitchen top next to the coffee jug while waiting for water to go through the coffee.
With my left hand, pick up the coffee cup from the kitchen top.
With my right hand, pick up a small sponge from the small drying rack attached inside the sink.
With my right hand, turn on the tap while holding the cup under the tap with my left hand.
Pour a little tap water into the coffee cup so that I can wash the cup.
While holding the coffee cup in my left hand, use the sponge in my right hand to wash the cup. I move the sponge along the inside of the cup to remove coffee residue from the cup.
Turn on the tap again with my right hand.
Continue washing the cup, this time using running tap water while still rubbing the sponge inside the coffee cup to remove coffee residue.
Turn off the tap with my right hand while holding the sponge in the same hand.
Place the now washed cup on the top shelf of the drying rack, located on top of the sink.
With my left hand, grab another dirty coffee cup from the kitchen top above the dishwasher.
While holding the cup under the tap with my left hand using my right hand, turn on the tap.

While holding the cup in my left hand, use the sponge in my right hand and running tap water to wash the cup. I rub the sponge along the brim of the cup and inside and outside the cup to remove the coffee residue.
With the back of my right hand, turn off the tap.
Continue washing the cup, now without running tap water, by rubbing the sponge initially in the inside of the cup then on the outside too.
Squeeze the sponge using my right hand to remove excess water from the sponge.
Drop the sponge into the small drying rack attached to the sink.
While holding the cup with my left hand, using the right hand turn on the tap.
Rinse the cup using running tap water, rotating the cup in a horizontal motion so that water distributes well inside the cup and rinses the cup thoroughly.
With my left hand, flip the cup to remove excess water from the cup.
With my right hand, turn off the tap.
I accidentally drop the coffee cup which slips off my right hand. Fortunately, the cup doesn't break.
Pick up the cup again from the sink and shake it to remove more water from the cup.
Place the now washed cup on the top shelf of the drying rack next to the other cap.
Shake both hands above the sink to shake off water from my hands.
Grab the cloth from the kitchen top using my right hand.
Use the cloth to dry both hands.
With my right hand, pick up a kettle from the kitchen top.
Shake my hands above the sink to remove water droplets.
Grab the cloth with my right hand to dry my hands.
Dry both hands using the cloth I just picked up.
Drop the cloth with my right hand where it was on the kitchen top next to the hob.
Pour water slowly and in a rotating motion into the V60 coffee filter to brew coffee.
Put down the kettle with my right hand on the kitchen top next to the coffee jug.
Hang the cloth on the cupboard under the sink.
With my left hand, close the cupboard by pulling it towards me.
With my left hand, open now the smaller cupboard on the right hand side with my left hand.
Not finding what I was looking for, close again the cupboard with my left hand.
With my right hand, open the cupboard on the corner.
With my left hand, pick up the Nutella jar from the middle shelf of the cupboard.
Put down the Nutella jar on the kitchen top between the hob and the toaster.
With my right hand, close the cupboard by pushing it.
Pick up the kettle with my right hand from the kitchen top.
Pour water slowly and in a rotating motion from the kettle into the V60 coffee filter to brew coffee.
Put down the kettle on the countertop next to the coffee jug while waiting for the water to go through the coffee.
With my right hand, pick up the kettle from the kitchen top.
Pour water slowly and in a rotating motion from the kettle into the V60 coffee filter to brew coffee.
Put down the kettle on the kitchen top next to the coffee jug.
Pick up a kettle from the kitchen top with my right hand.
Pour water slowly and in a rotating motion from the kettle into the V60 filter to brew coffee.
Put down the kettle on the kitchen top next to the plates and a coffee jug while waiting for the water to go through the coffee.
Pour water slowly and in a rotating motion from the kettle into the V60 coffee filter to brew the coffee.
Put down the kettle on the kitchen top while waiting for the water to go through the coffee.
Pick up a kettle from the kitchen top with my right hand.
Pour water slowly and in a rotating motion from the kettle into the V60 filter to brew the coffee.
With my right hand, pick up the kettle from the kitchen top next to the coffee jug.
With my right hand, tilt the kettle to pour water into the V60 metal filter. I pour water slowly and in a rotating motion to better brew the coffee.
Put the kettle down on the kitchen top as I wait for the water to go through the coffee filter.
With my right hand, pick up the kettle from the kitchen top.
Tilt the kettle to pour more water into the V60 metal filter to brew coffee. I pour water slowly and in a rotating motion to brew the coffee in a better way.
Put down the kettle on the kitchen top with my right hand.
With my right hand, pick up the kettle from the kitchen top.

Tilt the kettle to pour more water into the V60 metal filter to brew the coffee. I pour water slowly and in a rotating motion to distribute the water evenly in the V60 filter to better brew the coffee.
Put the kettle down on the kitchen top with my right hand.
With my right hand, pick up the toaster from the bottom shelf of the cupboard.
Tilt the kettle to pour more water into the V60 metal filter. I pour water slowly and in a rotating motion to distribute the water evenly in the coffee filter to brew the coffee in a better way.
Put down the kettle on the kitchen top with my right hand.
With my right hand, pick up the kettle from the kitchen top.
Tilt the kettle to pour more water into the V60 metal filter to brew the coffee. I pour the water slowly and in a rotating motion to brew the coffee properly.
Put the kettle down on the kitchen top with my right hand.
Tilt the kettle to pour more water into the V60 metal filter, pouring water slowly and in a rotating motion so that the water is distributed evenly to brew better coffee.
Put the kettle down on the kitchen top with my right hand.

Tilt the kettle to pour more water into the V60 metal filter to brew the coffee. I pour water slowly and in a rotating motion so that the water is well distributed in the filter to brew better coffee.
Put the kettle down on the kitchen top with my right hand.
Tilt the kettle to pour more water into the V60 metal filter and brew the coffee. I pour the water slowly and in a rotating motion to brew the coffee properly.
Place the kettle down on the kitchen top with my right hand.
Pick up the ketchup from the kitchen top with my right hand.
Tilt the kettle to pour more water into the V60 metal filter to brew coffee. I pour water slowly and in a rotating motion to brew coffee properly.
Put the kettle down on the kitchen top with my right hand.
